in_hebrew.name: Jubion
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Rejoicing or Exulting
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Jubion הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. The name Jubion is derived from the Hebrew word ‘yubal’ which means ‘to rejoice’ or ‘to exult’. It is also linked to the Greek word ‘jubaeo’ meaning ‘to shout’ or ‘to cry out’ in joy. In the Bible, the name Jubal is given to the father of all musicians, highlighting the joyful and musical nature of this name.
